register_extensions: register xFormers C++ extensions by loading the shared library and registering custom ops
create_buildinfo: create a _BuildInfo dataclass instance from build metadata dictionary containing version and env info
test_buildinfo_properties: test _BuildInfo properties to extract cuda, hip, torch, python, flash versions and build environment
handle_not_built_exception: handle xFormersWasNotBuiltException when C++ extensions were not compiled during installation
handle_invalid_lib_exception: handle xFormersInvalidLibException when built library mismatches current PyTorch or Python version
